cs.t: Filco Majestouch Ninja Tenkeyless [1] It's a mouthful, but the important points are 1) mechanical switches (mine has Cherry brown switches), 2) heavy -- it feels solid and stays put on your desk, and 3) no numpad. I guess there's also 4) it looks cool. It's the best keyboard I've ever used. [1]  http://www.diatec.co.jp/en/det.php?prod_c=775
